page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes. Running head with page number at the top. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: maximo dolore & miseratione intueor, cum sim in Urbem & Parlamenta animo valde be-nevolo; ut non possim non serio deplorare, duo haec Regni nostri conspicua maxime & insignia Corpora tam indigna se pati vel facere.

Bené tamen hactenus processit, quòd ista gravis utcunque conquassatio, in terrorem tantum, & in domandos spiritus, non ad ruinam processit, nunquam enim tam malè de hac Urbe opinatus sum, ut de futuro illius obsequio & fide desperaverim, quae licet praesens forsan error obtenebret, nunquam penitus Malitia extinguet.

Tota utinam ab illis sic procella transfierit; quos non secus contemplor ac Christus ipse Ierusalem, precibus meis & lachrymis & moerore dignissimos, cùm multo olim graviores dispersiones prospiciam necessario illis eventuras, qui merâ suâ petulantiâ in officio manere noluerant: cum sit quaedam fatalis occaecatio voluntariae comes & supplicium: ut jam nec liberum sit postea vel aerumnas defugere qui maturè de peccatis resipiscere nolebant, vel unquam frui Pacis gaudio qui Consilia Pacis aspernabantur. Id enim tandem reperient, Fra-tres istor[?] in malo proximè in Hostes abituros, cùm sit nil difficilius, quàm ut sint Improbi diù unanimes.

page.notes: Running head and the Greek word "ΒΑΣΙΑΙΚΗ" are uncertain; the third letter of the Greek title is read as Α, which may be Λ. "istor[?]" in the italic phrase "Fratres istor in malo" is not clearly legible; the scan shows a short word between "Fratres" and "in", which may be a misprint. "Bené" has a doubtful accent. The catchword "lud" completes the word "illud" on the next page.
